title: SHA-256 with CryptoKit
hints: Hash the UTF-8 bytes, then hex-encode each byte with two lowercase digits.
jsBridge: `SHA256.hash(data:)` from CryptoKit is Node's `crypto.createHash('sha256')`. Unlike `hashValue`, a cryptographic hash is stable across launches and machines, so use it for checksums and cache keys.
